scientific.integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the model equations, disease-free equilibrium, next-generation reproduction number, Figure 1 contour analysis, Table 1 parameters, and discussion. The model and reproduction-number pages and the Figure 1/Table 1 page were visually inspected. Two highly relevant awareness/media primary papers were inspected for broader implication coverage. The bundled exact checker reconstructs the formulas and source-parameter values. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result classifies reachability of the source's subunit reproduction-number threshold and hence its local disease-free stability condition. It does not supply a new global-stability theorem or an economic optimization of media effort.

title: A hard baseline-advertising barrier to crossing the disease-free threshold
